title: Document Segment statistics cards and the segment_source Contact search filter
author: promptless-for-oss
body:
[Open this suggestion in Promptless to view citations and reasoning process](https://app.gopromptless.ai/suggestions/efb9ce40-fd9a-4d4d-9dee-27938cc50ec5)

## Description

Documents the Segment statistics cards and the new Contact search filter added in [mautic/mautic#16350](https://github.com/mautic/mautic/pull/16350), which is now merged into `7.x`.

* `docs/segments/manage_segments.rst`: adds a "Viewing a Segment's statistics" section with a screenshot. It describes the **Total contacts**, **Active contacts**, **Manually added contacts**, and **Filter added contacts** cards, which link to the filtered Contacts list. **Active contacts** excludes Contacts marked as Do Not Contact for Email. **Manually added contacts** lists every way a Contact joins a Segment outside its filters. **Filter added contacts** appears only for Segments with filters.
* `docs/search/search_operators.rst`: adds the `segment_source:manually_added` and `segment_source:filter_added` Contact search filters, with a note that they only work together with `segment:{segment_alias}`.

This update merges the latest `7.3` and aligns the content with the merged code: the search command is `segment_source`, not `source`, and the card descriptions match the final tooltips.

Vale reports no new findings on the changed files.

title: docs: Document PostgreSQL database support for Mautic 7.x
author: promptless-for-oss
body:
[Open this suggestion in Promptless to view citations and reasoning process](https://app.gopromptless.ai/suggestions/cb9d8a7e-fffe-4185-a670-157aa1701b0a)

Documents the reintroduction of PostgreSQL database support in Mautic 7.x (mautic/mautic#15926).

## Changes

**Development setup** (`docs/development-environment/setup.rst`):
- Added PostgreSQL configuration example alongside MySQL
- Includes driver, port, and extension requirements

**Database compatibility** (`docs/plugins/database.rst`):
- New "Database compatibility" section with comprehensive guidance
- Documents supported databases table (MySQL 8.0+, MariaDB 10.6+, PostgreSQL 16+)
- Case-insensitive string matching helpers (`getILikeExpression`, `getLowerLikeExpression`)
- Column/alias quoting requirements for `camelCase` identifiers
- GROUP BY strictness differences between platforms
- Platform detection methods and best practices

**Testing** (`docs/testing/e2e_test_suite.rst`):
- Added "Testing on multiple databases" section
- Documents tested database versions (PostgreSQL 16/18, MariaDB 10.11/11.4, MySQL 8.4/9.4)
- PostgreSQL test environment configuration
- Database-specific test considerations

## Why this matters for developers

- Developers can now choose PostgreSQL as their database platform
- Clear guidance on writing database-agnostic queries prevents runtime errors
- Helper methods in `CommonRepository` abstract platform differences
- Testing guidance helps ensure Plugins work across all databases

**Source:** [PR #15926](https://github.com/mautic/mautic/pull/15926) - Reintroducing PostgreSQL Database Support in Mautic 7.x

The impulse to create such an overview for mautic 4 was made by Sven Döring.
Sven Döring offered and did already the first proofreading/review. 

Thanks a lot for that to Sven Döring.
